wnba.headline: On 2026 Mondays, the default sort (last-ten production x games) put 3.3 of the week's ten best pickups in its top ten. The best of the newer signals, board's projected line x games, put 3.9 (+0.56, t = 1.7), and ranks the week better too. With players listed Out left out, as the page's Health filter does by default, it put 3.9 against the default's 3.7, still ahead.

With players listed Out left out, as the page's Health filter does by default, it put 1.8 against the default's 1.8: the filter already has its gain.
